{
  "dataset_name": "pima_diabetes",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gpt-5.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "glucose_zscore_clipped",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Clipped z-score of plasma glucose using the training-fold mean and standard deviation, with zero treated as an implausible entry and replaced by the fold mean before scaling.",
      "value_range": [
        -3.0,
        3.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "normalized_core_measurement",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Supplies a normalized glycemic axis so the margin can use this high-scale measurement without scale dominance.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.where(plas > 0.0, plas, 119.20434782608696) - 119.20434782608696) / 31.280456160646818, -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "bmi_zscore_clipped",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Clipped z-score of mass, the BMI column, using training-fold scaling and mean replacement for zero.",
      "value_range": [
        -3.0,
        3.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "normalized_core_measurement",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Keeps adiposity contribution on a comparable numeric scale for a linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.where(mass > 0.0, mass, 31.211304347826086) - 31.211304347826086) / 7.5253053119330096, -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "blood_pressure_zscore_clipped",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Clipped z-score of diastolic blood pressure using training-fold scaling and mean replacement for zero.",
      "value_range": [
        -3.0,
        3.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "normalized_core_measurement",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds vascular stress information on the same scale as other normalized measurements.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.where(pres > 0.0, pres, 68.06521739130434) - 68.06521739130434) / 18.528241867264995, -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_zscore_clipped",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Clipped z-score of age using training-fold scaling.",
      "value_range": [
        -3.0,
        3.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "normalized_core_measurement",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Places aging effects on a smooth centered axis that is easy for a linear SVM to weight.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((age - 32.93913043478261) / 11.313160444537871, -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "pedigree_zscore_clipped",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Clipped z-score of diabetes pedigree function using training-fold scaling.",
      "value_range": [
        -3.0,
        3.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "normalized_core_measurement",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides heritable-disposition signal as a scaled continuous input.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((pedi - 0.4640739130434782) / 0.31212679797659615, -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "insulin_glucose_log_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled insulin-to-glucose ratio after replacing impossible zero insulin or glucose entries with training-fold means.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        3.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "physiology_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures relative insulin response with reduced skew, giving the margin a compact metabolic balance feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.log1p(np.where(insu > 0.0, insu, 70.76086956521739) / np.maximum(np.where(plas > 0.0, plas, 119.20434782608696), 1.0)), 0.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "skin_bmi_ratio_clipped",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Skin-thickness-to-BMI ratio after replacing impossible zero skin or mass entries with training-fold means.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        2.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "body_composition_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds body-composition shape information that is more scale-stable than either raw measure alone.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.where(skin > 0.0, skin, 18.291304347826088) / np.maximum(np.where(mass > 0.0, mass, 31.211304347826086), 1.0), 0.0, 2.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "pregnancy_age_ratio_clipped",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Pregnancy count divided by approximate post-puberty age exposure, clipped to a compact range.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        2.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "exposure_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Represents reproductive-history exposure as an interaction-like continuous feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(preg / np.maximum(age - 14.0, 1.0), 0.0, 2.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "zero_measurement_fraction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of core physiological measurements recorded as zero among plas, pres, skin, insu, and mass.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "data_quality",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives the margin a normalized artifact burden signal so impossible entries can be handled separately from physiology.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(plas <= 0.0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(pres <= 0.0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(skin <= 0.0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(insu <= 0.0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(mass <= 0.0, 1.0, 0.0)) / 5.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "metabolic_linear_projection",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted projection of glucose, BMI, age, pedigree, and pressure z-scores using unsupervised training-fold scaling.",
      "value_range": [
        -3.0,
        3.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "composite_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Offers an approximate linear medical projection with balanced scales, useful for a single-margin learner.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.40 * np.clip((np.where(plas > 0.0, plas, 119.20434782608696) - 119.20434782608696) / 31.280456160646818, -3.0, 3.0) + 0.25 * np.clip((np.where(mass > 0.0, mass, 31.211304347826086) - 31.211304347826086) / 7.5253053119330096, -3.0, 3.0) + 0.15 * np.clip((age - 32.93913043478261) / 11.313160444537871, -3.0, 3.0) + 0.10 * np.clip((pedi - 0.4640739130434782) / 0.31212679797659615, -3.0, 3.0) + 0.10 * np.clip((np.where(pres > 0.0, pres, 68.06521739130434) - 68.06521739130434) / 18.528241867264995, -3.0, 3.0), -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "cardiometabolic_pattern_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Numeric assessor score from 0 to 1 reflecting how coherent the row appears as a cardiometabolic concern pattern when considering plas, mass, pres, age, pedi, preg, skin, and insu together; 0 denotes little concern pattern, 1 denotes strong concern pattern.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_medical_pattern",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a monotone, domain-informed synthesis of cross-column context that a linear margin can use as one smooth axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "measurement_quality_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Numeric assessor score from 0 to 1 for credibility of row measurements based on impossible zeros and cross-checks such as insulin versus plasma glucose and skin thickness versus BMI; 0 denotes very questionable, 1 denotes highly credible.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_data_quality",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Helps reduce the influence of artifacts by giving the margin a continuous reliability axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
